body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Casio presented an ultra-slim DLP projector ''XJ-S35'' during CES 2007, which is 4.3cm thick at 1.8kg. It just fits well with a suit case.
It can project 60-inch screen from 1.7m or 100-inch from 2.8m distance. By using a USB port, users can make presentation directly with the XJ-S35 without the need for pc
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
